title: Field computing: from persistent flow objects to addressed writes
summary: -mp-ri tested whether coherent structures in a nonlinear fluid could serve as persistent routing objects and exposed the key limitation that its useful write rule was added rather than generated by Navier-Stokes itself. InformationFlow keeps the slow-field routing idea but explicitly replaces the failed carrier-free binding mechanism with spatial, frequency and phase addressed coherent products.

nodes.claim: Tests a nonlinear incompressible fluid as a computer whose persistent vortex objects act as a routing operator and whose fast activations can interfere and write back into slower structure.
nodes.survived: Persistent coherent structures can function as tunable routing objects, overlapping fast packets create stronger nonlinear interaction than separated packets, and an added local eligibility rule can write the slow operator so later responses change.
nodes.killed: The useful Gate-5 plasticity rule was externally added rather than emerging from Navier-Stokes itself. A selective persistent functional write caused by the fluid interaction alone remained unresolved.

nodes.claim: Uses coherent carrier multiplication so spatial overlap, frequency and relative phase address selected quadratic interactions that write a slower divergence-free routing field.
nodes.survived: Carrier addressing supplies separate WHERE, WHICH and SIGN selectors; a matched pair writes a much stronger slow route than spatial or frequency controls, and relative phase can suppress or reverse the routing write.
nodes.killed: The coupling is explicit: this does not show that unmodified Navier-Stokes discovers the addressing scheme, that the mechanism is quantum computation, or that it has an advantage over standard learned or signal-processing systems.

edges.why: InformationFlow explicitly identifies -mp-ri's carrier-free fluid-synapse attacker as its immediate predecessor: the medium changed but failed to isolate the desired associative route, so InformationFlow replaces that binding layer with coherent spatial/frequency/phase addressing while retaining the slow-field routing idea.
